cards.back: Buffer zone between the Internet (Untrust) and the internal network (Trust): public servers are exposed there without exposing the internal network.
A preventive control is inline on the path; a detective control can be out-of-band via SPAN/tap.
All interaction points with a system: ports, services, accounts, APIs. Reduce by closing what is unnecessary.
Varying vendors, hardware, and mechanisms so a single flaw does not affect the entire environment.
If the control fails, traffic passes: availability prioritized, risk of bypass.
If the control fails, traffic is blocked: security prioritized, risk of outage.
Never trust, always verify: no implicit trust, even inside the network.
User authentication, device health, device inventory, application access control.
Device state: patches, antivirus, encryption, posture compliance.
An uninventoried device is denied or quarantined before any application access.
Encrypts remote traffic and authenticates the tunnel; does not replace per-session application access control.
Encrypted encapsulation of traffic between two points, used for remote access and interconnections.
Administration network separated from production; a jump host/bastion is the single entry point with MFA and recorded sessions.
Cloud-delivered security services (proxy, filtering, DLP, access control) to replace or supplement a VPN.
Group Managed Service Account: service account password managed and automatically rotated by the directory.
Accumulation of permissions across role changes; countered by least privilege and periodic access reviews.
End-to-end encrypted messaging: the provider cannot read the contents of exchanges.
Dedicated, logged channel with content inspection and authentication at both ends.
